reliquary-lantern.origin: top of the bail; hangs along -Y

cog-crown.origin: centre of the head ring, +Y up, front -Z

gear-cathedral-gate.description: 15 m gothic gate with a gear rose window; walk through the 4 m opening (faces +Z)

colossus-head.description: 9 m broken colossus head half-buried, one glowing eye, gear halo; looks up and toward +Z

floating-shrine.description: floating rock island with a gold-roofed shrine and three static gimbal rings; hovers 1 m above y=0

floating-shrine-core.description: the floating shrine without rings; pair with shrine-rings at height 6.9 m (rotate the rings object)

shrine-rings.description: three gimbal rings centred on the origin (r 3.7 / 4.4 / 5.1); place at the shrine core and spin rotation.y

rune-obelisk-a.description: 6.8 m four-sided rune obelisk with glowing circuit runes on every face and a floating crystal capstone

rune-obelisk-b.description: 6.9 m hexagonal tiered rune obelisk with gold bands and floating gear rings around a crystal

rune-obelisk-c.description: 3 m snapped rune obelisk, upper half fallen against the stump, crystals sprouting from the break

pilgrim-altar.description: 6 m octagonal pilgrims dais: altar with offering orb and a standing gold ring framing the sky; faces +Z (kneel on the -Z side cushions and look out through the ring)

waystone.description: standing stone with a blank dark plaque 1.0x1.3 m for a text plane (centre [0,1.55,0.32], faces +Z) and a two-arm signpost beside it

cog-familiar.desc: small friendly brass cog companion, 0.7 m, spinning cog ears and back cog

weapon-rack.description: 2.6 m wooden weapon rack with 3 swords, spear, axe and a round shield (decor, front faces +Z)

spell-lectern.description: 1.8 m stone lectern with an open glowing spellbook tilted toward +Z and a floating crystal orb with rings

ruined-arch.description: 4.6 m ruined stone arch: one full pillar with a half arch, one broken pillar, rubble and crystals; frame the view through the 3.4 m gap (axis along X, faces +Z)

jetty.description: 8 m wooden jetty on piles for the lake; origin at the shore end, extends toward +Z; deck is 0.55 m above y=0 and piles go 1.5 m below, so set y at the water surface

camp-tent.description: 2.4x2.8 m ridge tent with a bedroll beside it; door faces +Z

camp-log-seat.description: three log seats arranged around a campfire (radius ~1.7 m around the point (0,1.0)); stump block and cushion

camp-tripod.description: 1.6 m iron cooking tripod with a hanging pot; place over the existing campfire

clockwork-rabbit.desc: hopping brass wind-up rabbit with a spinning key, 0.7 m with ears

brass-firefly.desc: tiny brass dragonfly with glowing abdomen (spawn many; wings buzz in every clip), 0.5 m span

moss-grazer.desc: huge gentle moss-backed quadruped with mushrooms and rocks on its back, 1.9 m tall, extra clip graze

scrap-goblin.desc: first easy enemy: hunched goblin with bucket helmet and rusty cleaver, 1.35 m

rust-beetle.desc: easy enemy: rust-plated six-legged beetle with horn and mandibles, 0.85 m long, flips on its back when it dies

wisp.desc: easy enemy / ambient: drifting glowing wisp with orbiting motes, 0.9 m, shrinks away on death

training-dummy.desc: clockwork practice dummy on a geared base with target on its chest, 2.1 m, sways when hit

spell-tome.origin: centre of the spine; cover faces -Z

gear-halo.origin: ring centre (float ~0.28 m above the head), +Y up

clockwork-sentinel.desc: first mini-boss: 3.5 m brass-and-steel automaton knight with a glowing core, hammer fist and shield, spinning back cog

kaykit-rig-adventurers.title: KayKit Adventurers animation set (Rig_Medium): general human clips

kaykit-rig-skeletons.title: KayKit Skeletons animation set (Rig_Medium): includes spawn/awaken/taunt/death-C clips
